drivingQuestion: How do the women attribute the blood to one another?
outcomeNote: Baraita cited to explain the mishna; continues in the next unit

segments.he: וְתוֹלוֹת זוֹ בָּזוֹ. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: כֵּיצַד תּוֹלוֹת זוֹ בָּזוֹ? עוּבָּרָה וְשֶׁאֵינָהּ עוּבָּרָה — תּוֹלָה עוּבָּרָה בְּשֶׁאֵינָהּ עוּבָּרָה.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «And» with regard to three women who were sleeping in one bed and blood was discovered beneath one of them, that if one of them is unfit to menstruate «they attribute» the blood «to each other,» i.e., to the women who are fit to menstruate. In this regard, «the Sages taught» in a baraita: «How do they attribute» the blood to «one another?» If one of the women is «pregnant and» one «is not pregnant,» the «pregnant» woman «may attribute» the blood «to the» woman «who is not pregnant.»
